test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If A can do a work in 21 days and B can do the same work in 28 days. In how many days will they complete the work if they work on alternate days?
solution:
A's work time = 21 days

B's work time = 28 days

Find time to complete work if A and B work alternately

**Concept: **Work done is inversely proportional to time taken. If they work on alternate days, their work done adds up.

**Solution:**

A's work/day = 1/21

B's work/day = 1/28

Work done by A and B in 2 days = 1/21 + 1/28 = 4/84 + 3/84 = 7/84

Time taken for 1 complete work = 2 × 84/7 = 24 days

**Hence, they will complete the work in 24 days.**
